source.citation: Huang et al., Quantum recoil in free-electron interactions with atomic lattices, Nat. Photon. 17, 224-230 (2023), Supplementary Information
source.method: Text extraction (pdftotext -layout) of SI Table S4, visually checked against PDF page 17 (SI page 16). Observation angles from main-text Methods ('X-ray measurements'); interlayer c spacings from main-text Fig. 2 labels.

conventions.beam: +z (lab), electrons travel roughly along the crystal [001] axis
conventions.tilt: theta_til/phi_til: polar/azimuth of the [001] axis in the lab frame (paper Eq. 5)
conventions.observation: theta_obs polar from +z, phi_obs = 0 (detector in the x-z plane)
conventions.reflection: paper label (0 0 -m) with g = -m 2 pi / c [001]; PyRITE's recoil sign is the negation, g = +m 2 pi / c [001]
conventions.tilts_are_fitted: Table S4 tilts were fitted to the measured lines with the paper's quantum model; only 2*E2 - E4 is fit-independent (classical value 0 for any tilt)
